reasoning: The extract has no references or links, so I scored only the quoted lines. It reaches Level 2, not Level 3. Para 3.3 says "Quantitative and qualitative metrics to assess the impact of these actions will be developed". It names the outcome areas (Pursue, Prevent, Protect) and example measures: prosecution, asset recovery and disruption statistics, changes in criminals' and professionals' behaviour, and public and private sector understanding of the threat. That outlines the process for developing success measures. Evaluation plans are also given. The Criminal Finances Board oversees effectiveness (3.4), with input from the Financial Sector Forum. The Terrorist Finance Board monitors delivery (3.5). There is a dated timetable: a baseline assessment by summer 2016, a National Risk Assessment update in 2017, a second NRA ahead of the FATF Mutual Evaluation in 2017/18 or 2018, and "Its impact will be fully evaluated on completion". The strongest counter-example to Level 2 is that no testing or piloting is described, and no reason is given for omitting it. The measures are also not yet defined. Against Level 3, the extract does not explain why these evaluation methods were chosen. It does not say what will happen to the results, and it makes no commitment to publish them. Several lines are vague, such as "keep under review". To reach Level 3 the document would have to justify its evaluation approach, state whether and when the findings will be published, and say how the results will inform later policy. It should also say whether testing was considered.
